Developers

Everything the command-line interface does is available over HTTP, together with an MCP server for AI agents.

The HTTP API

curl -s https://ai.oimlsmart.org/api/ask \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"query":"What is OIML R 60?","stream":false}'

The answer document carries the answer text, the citations array with the quality and status of each source, the confidence_note statement, the source_quality rung and the quota echo. Requests with stream:true answer with server-sent events that report the interpretation of the question, the citations, the answer tokens and the completion. The complete surface is described by the OpenAPI document, which covers asking, search, absence, verification, research and the member-data routes. The MCP server speaks at https://ai.oimlsmart.org/mcp.

Authentication

Anonymous callers receive the public tier and are rate limited by address. Members authenticate at the OIML SMART identity service, id.oimlsmart.org. The web application uses the authorization-code flow with PKCE, and command-line clients use the Device Authorization Grant (RFC 8628), which issues a personal access token scoped with the <service>:<read|write|admin> grammar. Resource servers confirm every token through RFC 7662 introspection, so a revocation or a role change takes effect within seconds.

The OIML SMART programme

  • ai.oimlsmart.org — the Ommisa web application
  • id.oimlsmart.org — the identity service and account console
  • the OIML-CS certificate browser
  • oimlsmart.org — the OIML SMART programme
Ommisa is part of the OIML SMART programme — a public pilot. Answers are for information only; the official OIML publications govern.
